ThingDef.label: archotech shard
ThingDef.description: A shard of incomprehensibly advanced archotech material. Its internal structure rewrites itself constantly, maintaining a purpose that no current technology can fully decode. Analysis shows it contains knowledge orders of magnitude beyond spacer-level engineering. Found only in the ruins of civilizations that rose and fell long before humanity reached the stars — and in the hands of those brave enough to retrieve them.
